assumptions.statement: Official precise site and key-area polygons are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: All spatial calculations use repository provisional constraints and remain approximate.
assumptions.prohibited_claim: Do not call the provisional polygons an official redline or approval boundary.
assumptions.closure_action: Replace geometry, recompute every dependent metric and regenerate all artifacts after cleared official files arrive.

assumptions.statement: Approved land-use, FAR, height and other regulatory controls are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Land use, massing and program are conceptual design proposals rather than statutory controls.
assumptions.prohibited_claim: Do not state a confirmed FAR, building height, density or land-use approval.
assumptions.closure_action: Reconcile the design with approved planning conditions and update the standard/depth matrices.

assumptions.statement: Official road redlines, junction geometry, transit interfaces and parking requirements are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Road and slow-mobility geometry expresses network intent only.
assumptions.prohibited_claim: Do not treat centre lines as surveyed roads or approved redlines.
assumptions.closure_action: Replace with surveyed/approved networks and rerun accessibility, length and conflict checks.

assumptions.statement: Parcel ownership, tenure and implementation rights are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Project packaging does not assign a committed delivery entity or demolition right.
assumptions.prohibited_claim: Do not claim acquisition, relocation, demolition authority or owner consent.
assumptions.closure_action: Overlay cleared cadastral and ownership records and establish rights before project approval.

assumptions.statement: A surveyed existing-building inventory and engineering condition assessment are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Building footprints are reversible conceptual carriers; retain/renovate/demolish decisions remain unresolved.
assumptions.prohibited_claim: Do not present conceptual footprints as surveyed existing buildings or confirmed demolition.
assumptions.closure_action: Complete survey and structural assessment, then classify retain, renovate and remove building by building.

assumptions.statement: Verified municipal capacity, underground utilities and energy/carbon baselines are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Infrastructure strategies remain performance requirements without project capacity claims.
assumptions.prohibited_claim: Do not promise utility capacity, energy savings or construction feasibility.
assumptions.closure_action: Obtain utility surveys and operator capacity letters, then test loads and revise phasing.

assumptions.statement: Precise heritage protection boundaries and conservation requirements are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Railway-memory design is narrative and public-space intent, not a heritage approval conclusion.
assumptions.prohibited_claim: Do not infer protected-object boundaries or intervention permission.
assumptions.closure_action: Overlay official heritage files and obtain conservation review before physical intervention.

assumptions.statement: Investment, procurement, operator commitment and approved construction schedules are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: The 0–12, 12–36 and 36+ month sequence is a conceptual governance rhythm.
assumptions.prohibited_claim: Do not state committed investment, tender, operator appointment or government schedule.
assumptions.closure_action: Establish business case, accountable operators, procurement route and approved programme before delivery.
